anchor.statement: Lemma A.5. Let E id,sched be the reference inner profile (A.7) followed by the outer profile E specified in Section A.2, with the azimuthal corrections that preserve the total pressure increment omitted and all other transition intervals unchanged. The function Π 0 ( η ) = − 1 2 ∫︂ ∞ − ∞ E id,sched (y, η ) 2 dy (A.21) is independent of X R and analytic on a complex neighborhood of [−1, 1]. It is even, Π′ 0 ( η ) has the sign of η for η ̸= 0, and Π 0 ( η ) ≤ − 5 2 P 2 ∗ f ( η ) 2 . (A.22) For the complete reference radial profile, integration of Π X = E 2 /(2X) from this datum gives Π (X, η ) = − 1 2 ∫︂ ∞ log(X/X R ) E(v, η ) 2 dv. (A.23)

correspondence.note: Split into the bound Π0(η) ≤ −(5/2) P∗² f(η)², analyticity of a complex extension on the strip |Im z| < 1/2, evenness, the sign of Π0′ for η > 0 and η < 0, XR-independence, and (A.23) as the pressure_canonical field of the profile specification (written as −(1/2)∫_X^∞ E(u)²/u du in the radial variable).
